info.title: API.SH: Imovirtual
info.description: The Imovirtual API from API.SH: public Imovirtual data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/imovirtual-listing

The Portuguese places Imovirtual suggests for what was typed: districts, councils, parishes and neighborhoods, each with the location path the search endpoint takes, its level, full name, parents and a ready-made search link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: Comma-separated levels to keep: district, council, parish, neighborhood, street.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Imovirtual new developments and their units
get.description:
New-build developments in Portugal on Imovirtual. Without `url`: a search of developments with the site's filters (location, price, area, price per m², build year, keywords, days since listed, radius, sort); each result has the summary fields of /imovirtual/v1/search plus construction state, estimated delivery (year and quarter), number of units, unit area range, unit rooms range and price from per m². With `url` (or `id`): one development with its description, state, start and finish dates, units in the project and listed, area and ceiling-height ranges, price from per m², floors, extra spaces, unit counts by rooms, location with coordinates, photos, video, the developer (name, page, logo, phones, address) and a page of its units: id, link, title, category, price, currency, price per m², area, plot area, rooms, floor, build year, finishing state, availability date, special offer, photos, floor plans and every characteristic, with the price, area and room facets. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/imovirtual-new-developments

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An imovirtual.com/pt/anuncio/... development link from the search results: returns that development and its units.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The development slug ending in -ID..., instead of `url`.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Search: location path as in imovirtual.com search links (district/council[/parish]). Default: all of Portugal.

parameters.name: days_since_created
parameters.description: Search: listed within this many days (1, 3, 7, 14, 30).

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Search: extra radius around the location (km).

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description: With `url`: only units with these room counts, comma-separated (1-10), e.g. 2,3.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order. Units (with `url`): price_asc (default), price_desc, area_asc, area_desc. Search: any of the values (default relevance).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Homes, land and commercial property for sale and rent in Portugal on Imovirtual with the site's filters: place, transaction, property type, price, area, price per m², rooms, build year, plot area, days since listed, radius, floors, extras, building type, advertiser type (private, agency, developer), new or resale, keywords, plus sort. Each result has id, link, title, property type, transaction, price, price per m², area, rooms, floor, street and place (district, council, parish), dates, promoted and exclusive flags, advertiser type, the agency or developer (name, type, page, logo; a private owner's name is left out), development details and photos. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/imovirtual-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Place path as in imovirtual.com links: a district (lisboa, porto, faro), a council (lisboa/cascais) or a parish path; default all of Portugal.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Or an imovirtual.com/pt/resultados/... search link (its filters are used as they are).

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description: Rooms (T0..T10), comma list of numbers; 11 = more.

parameters.name: days_since_created
parameters.description: Listed in the last N days (1, 3, 7, 14, 30).

parameters.name: floors
parameters.description: Floors, comma list as on the site (GROUND, FIRST, ... HIGHER_10, GARRET).

parameters.name: extras
parameters.description: Extras, comma list as on the site (BALCONY, TERRACE, GARAGE, LIFT, POOL, GARDEN, AIR_CONDITIONING...).

parameters.name: building_type
parameters.description: Building types, comma list as on the site (BLOCK, DETACHED, TERRACED...).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
